title: CRITICAL: wire button actions into published SWFs (DefineButton2 cond-actions + on()/onClipEvent authoring)
description: Biggest blocker for 'build a basic Flash game'. (1) packages/swf/src/buttons.ts writes ActionOffset=0 ('no button conditions for MVP', ~lines 139/303), so ALL button conditional actions are silently dropped from published SWFs. Task 0484's conditional-action encoder lives in button.ts but compile.ts calls buttons.ts — the encoder is unintegrated. Integrate it into the real publish path (usePublish -> compileDocument). (2) The document model has no per-instance scripts: 'script' exists only on keyframes (core/src/model/types.ts:82) and ActionsPanel is frame-only, so on()/onClipEvent authoring is impossible in the UI. Add per-instance script field to model + FLA serialize/deserialize + ActionsPanel mode (Actions - Button / Actions - Movie Clip). (3) Compile on(press/release/rollOver...){...} to BUTTONCONDACTION and onClipEvent(load/enterFrame/...) to PlaceObject2 clip actions. (4) Acceptance: e2e where clicking a published button in Ruffle visibly changes state. See docs/12-actionscript.md and docs/15-file-formats-fla-swf.md.
